svg.text: “Nothing is moving in the market right now.”
Pending contracts in Rio Vista are up 118% year-over-year.

33316 (Rio Vista, Harbor Beach) had 24 new contracts go pending in April. Last April it was 11. 33308 (Lauderdale-by-the-Sea) is up 39% YoY in pending. 33304 (Victoria Park) up 53%. Buyers ARE moving — they're moving selectively. Some neighborhoods are quietly transitioning while the headline narrative says everything is frozen.
